artifacts.summary: 11-phase, 11.5-hour promotion plan landing the audit's Completion lemma, the discrete-time Saturation-redundancy result, the partial-history/restriction identification, the Limit-only reflection law and the last two independence witnesses, plus three docstring corrections and an evidence-probe relocation for the one probe deliberately not promoted.

memory_candidates.content: In this repo, a sorry-free Lean probe written under specs/{NNN}_{SLUG}/probes/ is NOT a durable record: when /todo archives the task the whole directory moves to specs/archive/, which .gitignore excludes, so the probe leaves version control entirely (absent from a fresh clone). scripts/check-evidence-probes.sh documents this exact incident and the remedy: probes that record a DESIGN OBSTRUCTION (a machine-checked reason the code has the shape it has, e.g. 'this axiom must not be added because a frame the paper needs fails it') belong under specs/evidence/{collection}/, which is task-independent and tracked, and must be wired into that script's WIRED list so lake env lean compile-checks them outside the build graph. When planning a promotion round from a research task's probes, triage each probe into one of three outcomes: promote into FormalSystem/ (reusable positive content), relocate to specs/evidence/ and wire the guard (obstruction records, refuted conditions the library must not contain), or let it lapse (content fully superseded by a promoted declaration). Never leave an obstruction probe in the task directory. Note that the script's EVIDENCE variable is a single hard-coded directory, so adding a second collection requires generalizing its loop, not just appending to WIRED.

user_decision.question: The research round's open question (Saturation kept as stated vs. replaced by Completion in def:frame) is still unanswered. This plan takes the recommended branch -- Saturation stays, Completion lands as a LEMMA in a new Extension/Completion.lean. Confirm, or say to take R4 instead?
options: Confirm R1: keep Saturation as stated; Completion lands as a lemma in Extension/Completion.lean (the plan as written) - the ball-space anchoring and cor:saturation-finite are untouched, and the manuscript edit is an addition rather than a replacement

Take R4 instead: Completion becomes def:frame's fourth constraint - this relocates Completion out of Extension/Completion.lean into the constraint layer (FrameAxioms/TaskFrame), changes Phase 2's siting and Phase 9's wiring, and makes Compositionality drop out of thm:extension entirely
user_decision.recommended: Confirm R1: keep Saturation as stated; Completion lands as a lemma in Extension/Completion.lean (the plan as written) - the ball-space anchoring and cor:saturation-finite are untouched, and the manuscript edit is an addition rather than a replacement
